entries.006e6e74047048d8: This department operates restaurants. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥10,345 million. It also includes operation of restaurants under franchise agreements.
entries.024bc2b254ac159c: Upholding the founding corporate philosophies of “Zen no hassō” and “Jishu dokuritsu,” it sets its management policy as “aru beki sugata” and works to improve its human resource, system, merchandise and store capabilities. It thoroughly applies the “Seven Basics”: cleanliness, freshness and quality, product range, price, display techniques, service and correct labelling, and aims to raise customer satisfaction through revitalizing and streamlining existing stores. Regarding the food processing center, in response to the current center having been in operation for 40 years, it began construction of a new food processing center and a new head office in February 2026.
entries.0406782f37582061: Of revenue from external customers of ¥245,548 million, retail accounted for ¥236,191 million and CVS for ¥9,356 million, so retail is the core of the business. Its business is limited to Okinawa Prefecture. While growth in the number of visitors to Okinawa Prefecture supports the economy, the company views the retail industry as continuing to face a harsh business environment: under inflation, customers' inclination to economize is rising, and competition across store formats is intensifying.
